title: Attendance
subtitle: Staff check-ins and check-outs from the office fingerprint terminal

daily.subtitle: A day's first punch is the check-in and the last one the check-out. Arriving more than 30 minutes after the phone line opens (office phone hours, usually {{start}}) counts as late.
daily.label: One day's attendance

monthly.subtitle: Days present, hours and lateness per person. Arriving more than 30 minutes after the phone line opens (office phone hours, usually {{start}}) counts as late; its closed days are not absences.
monthly.label: One month's attendance

settings.subtitle: Connect each device number to an employee so the hours are counted under their name.
settings.label: Device numbers
settings.unmapped: {{n}} numbers are not connected to an employee. Their punches count for nobody.
settings.error: That did not work. Try again.
settings.readNamesAsked: Requested. The names are read the next time the device connects.

schedule.title: Working hours
schedule.subtitle: Each day's start is read from the office phone hours. Coming in up to {{n}} minutes after the start is on time.
schedule.notSaved: The office phone hours were never saved, so the phone system's default hours count.
